annotations.title: How a subscription business joins Fleek

description: For a business that sells a subscription and wants it carried by card, loyalty, employee-benefits, telco or creator programmes: the kinds of programme Fleek distributes to, the fulfilment options, what the merchant controls and sees, whether a market is covered, and the merchant sign-up link. market and category, when given, are recorded in the link's tracking tags.

category.description: The merchant's kind of subscription, e.g. 'fitness' or 'streaming'.

market.description: Where the merchant wants to be carried: ISO code, country name or region.
